Commands you can use here (man COMMAND explains each one):
Find your way       pwd  ls  cd  tree  find  which
Files and folders   mkdir  touch  cp  mv  rm  rmdir
Read and write      cat  less  head  tail  echo  printf  >  >>  <  <<
Work with text      grep  sort  uniq  wc  cut  |
Processes           sleep  sleep 100 &  jobs  ps  kill  wait  Ctrl + C
Scripts             nano  sh script.sh  ./script.sh  read  test  if  for  while  case
Everything else     man  help  date  clear  history
You can look anywhere, but only change things inside your home folder. Tab finishes names; ↑ brings back earlier commands.
